# Bounded completion and exploratory research checkpoint

Protocol frozen before new provider calls. Authority: the owner's “go ahead,
moving to next checkpoint”, continuing GLM 5.3 at maximum effort, BaoStock only,
the approved modular development plan and the original cumulative 200 CNY ceiling.

## Engineering and acceptance plan

- Bound model-visible board replies to 24000 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Large immutable
  sources and events are accessible by hash-pinned 2500-character pages. Keep native
  task receipts outside the full board; retain full private artifacts and logs.
- Give each actor one separate acknowledgement request in the same aggregate
  ledger. Worker work is capped at six calls, supervisor work at twelve, each arm
  at 36 total requests and six native tasks. Reserve acknowledgement slots inside
  the atomic cash admission transaction. Native errors remain errors after submission.
- Expose closed attempts without a suggested next fixed stage. Check structured
  source-derived counts and the recorded false prose patterns; disclose the grammar's
  limits. A clean model review cannot override a recognized count defect.
- Distinguish motivated hypotheses, exploratory candidate adoption and investment
  benefit. Hypothesis citations establish provenance, not profitable alpha. Preserve
  retention/defer/reject decisions. Never force a factor change.
- Put DSH's research workspace inside its own empty Git boundary, so unrelated
  development edits cannot appear as native research work.
- Pass offline regression and scripted native UI tests before live model dispatch.
  Then run one fixed/adaptive pair with identical frozen sources, code, settings and
  per-arm bounds. The fixed sequence is analyze/design/review. Adaptive follow-ups
  must reference observed findings/reviews. Record all attempted tasks and failures.

## Frozen new case and gradual data allowance

The convenience sample is 601318.XSHG, 600036.XSHG and 300750.XSHE, from 6 May through
31 July 2026. Freeze this selection before fetching; do not resample based on results.
Fetch one symbol for 6–8 May first, then its remaining two chunks, then repeat for
the other two symbols. Validate every chunk before the next. Nine BaoStock business
requests and nine anonymous logins are the maximum, with 261 new calendar-symbol
cells. Historical usage is 14 business/14 authentication requests and 459 cells;
the cumulative BaoStock bounds become 23/23/720. Paid-source caps and cutoff stay
unchanged. Require at least 40 observations per name and 40 common observed dates.
No labels, adjusted prices, corporate-action claims, holdout or evaluator tools.

Both arms receive the same new question: develop and inspect a source-motivated
short-horizon momentum hypothesis, compare descriptive coverage/scale with the
five-observation raw-return baseline, and adopt a research candidate or explicitly
retain. There is no predetermined winning specification or hidden correction key.
A substantive adaptive revision requires independent semantic acceptance to count
toward the minimal-core gate. One successful case cannot establish superiority,
profitable alpha, general discovery reliability or production readiness.

## Budget amendment and records

Before this package, the shared ledger records 40.411908 CNY accounted, 14.090240
reserved and 145.497852 unreserved, with 204 historical GLM attempts. The next pair
adds at most 72 calls; the local historical request cap is 276. The conservative
subscription-credit allowance becomes 6000 (previously 4000) and local historical
cash-exposure cap becomes 80 CNY (previously 60), within the unchanged 200 CNY total.
These are operator test ceilings, not provider quota readings or subscription invoices.
The old 401 and exact pre-HTTP timeout retain their complete reservations. The
timeout's fingerprinted continuation is restricted to the two newly named groups;
no old task is replayed and any new unknown blocks further dispatch.

For each stage retain UTC/Beijing times; source/config/prompt/package hashes;
actual native role/task/step/request IDs; complete model inputs/outputs and tool
receipts; accepted/rejected artifacts; inspections and independent Decimal audit;
input/output/cache tokens and rolling dispatch/completion TPM/RPM; conservative
CNY/credit debits and reservations; sampled process-tree CPU/RSS, host RAM/swap and
disk; UI screenshots/reload/console checks; semantic verdicts and known limitations.
Browser plugin is unavailable; use installed Chrome via Playwright. A successful UI
render is not research acceptance. Preserve all old evidence unchanged.

## Results

Pending execution. No new model or market-data calls at protocol creation.

study.authority: Owner: go ahead, moving to next checkpoint. Continue the approved modular plan, with the current GLM 5.3 maximum-effort selection and original 200 CNY total.
study.question: Develop an executable short-horizon close-momentum hypothesis for later independent evaluation on this new frozen A-share sample. Start from the five-observation raw return. Identify source-supported applicability constraints and motivate at most one alternative specification using the observed price/return profiles. Inspect the baseline and any motivated alternative, then explicitly choose a candidate for exploratory research or retain the baseline with reasons. No winning sign, lookback, normalization or return bound is prescribed. Lack of proven alpha is a limitation for later evaluation, not by itself grounds to reject exploration.
study.repeat_rule: One new fixed/adaptive pair only. Each actor has one separate acknowledgement request inside the 36-request aggregate. Run the next arm only after prior new usage is settled and arithmetic/evidence integrity passes. Record model failure or retention without forcing repair. Stop on any new unknown, quota exhaustion, data failure, or unresolved arithmetic/integrity failure; no automatic replay.
study.research_contract: This is exploratory hypothesis development, with no forward performance labels. Distinguish three decisions: inspect a motivated hypothesis; adopt or retain a research candidate with explicit assumptions; and demonstrate investment benefit in a separate future evaluation. Only the first two are in scope. Descriptive score differences cannot establish superiority. Compare coverage and score-scale consequences against the baseline; justify any added parameter or applicability exclusion from cited evidence and state what evidence would be needed next. A coherent retention or inconclusive proposal is allowed. Never manufacture a correction to satisfy a checkpoint, infer corporate actions from close-only jumps, or describe a volatility-scaled score as an annual Sharpe ratio.
